eeg_condition_baseline: Current direct EEG-feature L2 logistic leave-one-file-out cue-side model; compare all new state models on identical trials and folds.
feature_reconstruction_baseline: Training-fold mean feature vector and predefined V/H/P proxy regression; score held-out standardized RMSE and predictive log likelihood.
choice_baseline: Cue-side plus verified task-type logistic model; compare against the same model augmented with EEG-derived states to measure incremental EEG value.
rt_baseline: Training-fold median RT only after target time has been verified; use grouped leave-one-file/subject-out validation, never random 7:3 splitting.
uncertainty: Report each held-out file, fold range and sample counts; use group/block-aware intervals only when group count supports them.
